cefrAlignment: C1: precise degree and frequency adverbs, evidential markers (apparently, supposedly, presumably) and qualification (not so much X as Y, at least as far as…) match the C1 descriptors for vocabulary range and for expressing fine shades of meaning and degree of certainty.
examFidelity: IELTS Part 3 (no prep, 60 s) and TOEFL Take an Interview (no prep, 45 s) match exams.ts; the band 7 and band 8 Lexical Resource quotes are verbatim, and precise meaning is correctly attributed to band 8, not band 7.
openConcerns: The Part 3 model is 141 words for a 60-second timer (about 141 wpm). It is within range, but slower learners may not finish it
learnerOutcome: A learner can replace vague words like 'very', 'a lot' and 'sometimes' with precise degree, frequency and source expressions and qualify claims accurately, a key step from band 7 towards band 8 Lexical Resource.
